findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
 * @description User-controlled URLs used in HTTP requests without validation
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/fsspec-ssrf
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

module SSRFConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(DataFlow::ParameterNode param |
      source = param and
      param.getParameter().getName() in ["url", "path", "location", "endpoint", "host"]
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      sink = call.getArg(_) and
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("aiohttp").getMember("ClientSession").getReturn().getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
      )
    )
  }
}

module SSRFFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SSRFConfig>;
import SSRFFlow::PathGraph

from SSRFFlow::PathNode source, SSRFFlow::PathNode sink
where SSRFFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "SSRF: user-controlled URL flows to HTTP request $@.", source.getNode(), "from here"
findings.hypothesis: User-controlled URLs flow to HTTP requests without validation, potentially allowing SSRF attacks
